jordan: heads-up: multiple tenants seeing p99 jump for calypso-v2.2 after tokenizer change rolled this morning. p95 ~250ms -> ~480ms, p99 up to ~1.9s on very long inputs (>25k tokens).
monitor-bot: ALERT: model=calypso-v2.2 region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency value=1.91s threshold=1.5s
jordan: impacted customers: AcmeCorp, BrightByte, PennyLabs + a few small dev teams. Appears to start at 4801234588 post-deploy. Adding a sample request + logs.
jordan: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"calypso-v2.2","input":"<huge doc>...","max_tokens":256}'
```
jordan: tokenizer-server log (snip):
```
[4801234592] tokenizer: commit=f9e7c3 PR=912 feature=length-sampler-v2 input_tokens=28840 time_ms=520.4
[4801234592] runtime: kv_prefetch_wait_ms=240 cache_miss=true decode_ms=1100
```
maya: can you confirm if length-sampler-v2 was toggled cluster-wide? any feature flags?
jordan: rolled from canary -> global at 4801234560. no per-tenant flag exposed; ops missed a toggle gate.
sam: grabbing traces now. trace: 0x9a1b4f. spans show tokenize sync blocking kv prefetch which pushes decode later.
jordan: span summary:
span(tokenizer) 0..520ms
span(kv_prefetch) 520..760ms waiting on tokenizer
span(decode) 760..1700ms
raj: infra note: saw a pod restart in us-west-2 at 4801234720 (OOM retry) but autoscaler added nodes 4801234755. no network packet loss reported.
maya: quick hypothesis: length-sampler-v2 walks potential split points with an inner loop trying multiple heuristics, causing roughly O(n^2) work when token count > threshold. we didn't have microbench for 20k+ token inputs for that codepath.
lee: customer ops impact: AcmeCorp hit their p99 SLA and opened a ticket. we need a fast mitigation that minimizes churn. rollback of tokenizer immediately might be safer but could trigger other regressions. prefer targeted routing + admin overrides first.
jordan: proposed mitigations (now):
- pin affected tenants to calypso-v2.1 (legacy tokenizer) via admin override
- add route rule: if input_tokens > 20k, route to calypso-v2.1
- hotpatch runtime flag to disable kv-prefetch for calypso-v2.2 until fix
- add perf tests for 50k token inputs in CI
jordan: applied admin override for AcmeCorp + BrightByte and added temporary routing rule.
jordan: admin API call used:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/customers/ACME/override -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN" -d '{"model":"calypso-v2.1","tokenizer":"legacy","note":"hotfix 4801234799"}'
```
jordan: after overrides (~15m) AcmeCorp p99 dropped from 1.91s -> 0.24s; p95 back to ~220-270ms.
maya: i'll open a revert+fix PR: PR #920 will revert length-sampler-v2 and reintroduce a linear-scan with a fixed max-window, plus unit perf for extreme lengths.
sam: mid-term change: runtime should avoid blocking tokenizer RPCs on the critical path for kv-prefetch. add an async tokenization mode and circuit-breaker for long inputs. also add a per-model kv-prefetch opt-out flag.
raj: i'll push a hotpatch to set --kv-prefetch=false for calypso-v2.2 canary pods; ETA ~45m.
lee: Jordan please notify impacted customers with what we changed and expected timeline. keep support thread updated.
jordan: note posted to AcmeCorp support thread with PR link + ETA.
monitor-bot: RESOLVED ALERT: model=calypso-v2.2 region=us-west-2 metric=p99_latency new_value=0.23s
maya: follow-up actions:
- merge PR #920 after perf CI green
- add 50k token perf job to pre-merge checks
- implement per-tenant tokenizer toggle behind admin API
- add telemetry to surface long-input tokenization ms in console
jordan: agreed. i'll keep watch on canary re-rolls and coordinate the safe rollout once PR merged. closing thread unless new regressions surface. thanks all :thumbsup:
